rows.requirement: Research and develop strategies that generate useful signals
rows.assessment_note: Sixteen strategies are registered and evaluated; one passes all eight gates. The signals are hypotheses until gated, and most are rejected.
rows.blocking_gate: G1 — Sample size; G2 — Skill above variance; G3 — Calibration; G4 — Robustness; G6 — Economic reality
rows.clearance_criterion: G1: singles bets ≥ 500, two leg parlays tickets ≥ 300, three plus leg tickets ≥ 400, props tickets ≥ 500; assess on effective sample size (n_eff), not raw n. G2: z_skill >= 1.96 (two-sided 5%); bootstrap 95% interval on ROI excludes 0. G3: brier better than market-implied; log loss better than market-implied; reliability slope in [0.85, 1.15]. G4: edge sign stable across window halves; leave-one-team-out survives >= 28/32 refits; edge survives a second independent window; placebo shuffles do not reproduce edge; no 3-week block > 50% of profit. G6: edge survives using only release-time best quote; stake executable at recorded limit; all fees inside ROI; no implausible stake to produce claimed ROI.
